name: x-signal
description: Read-only X (Twitter) research for ChatGPT and Codex through a signed-in local browser.

interface.shortDescription: Research X from ChatGPT or Codex.
interface.longDescription: Search X, read feeds and threads, find accounts, monitor topics, and export evidence through a local signed-in browser.
defaultPrompt: Use X Signal to research what is happening on X and synthesize the evidence, using direct references when they improve the answer.
Use X Signal to compare discussion of these topics across Top, Latest, and relevant accounts.
